item.title: The Illusion of Precision: Numerical Instability of Large Language Models
item.description: Discovered microscopic input perturbations cause 10-million-fold amplification in LLMs, collapsing logit margins and triggering unpredictable token flips. This study highlights fundamental reliability gaps in current large language models.

item.title: Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Large Language Models
item.description:
• Developed an adversarial attack for LLMs using regularized gradients with continuous optimization to generate valid tokens.
  • Improved attack success rate by ~60% and reduced the time taken by 3 orders of magnitude, significantly enhancing efficiency.

item.title: Multimodal Classification with LLMs - Unstructured Text Feature Extraction
item.description:
• Created text processing pipelines with private LLMs for feature extraction through in-context learning.
  • Built fusion models combining unstructured and tabular data, boosting multimodal classification accuracy from 76% to 83%.
